# Postgrid

PostGrid provides APIs for automating direct mail and address verification services, enabling businesses to send letters, postcards, and checks, as well as verify and standardize addresses in real-time.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/postgrid/.

## Actions

- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact in postgrid.
- **Create Letter**: Create and send a letter via postgrid.
- **Create Template**: Create a new mail template in postgrid.
- **Create Webhook**: Create a new webhook to receive order event notifications.
- **CREATE_BANK_ACCOUNT**: Create a new bank account for print & mail service.
- **Get Bank Account** (read-only): Retrieve a bank account.
- **Get Contact** (read-only): Retrieve a contact.
- **Get Letter** (read-only): Retrieve a letter.
- **Get Template** (read-only): Retrieve a template.
- **Get Webhook** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific webhook by its id.
- **List Bank Accounts** (read-only): List bank accounts.
- **List Cheques** (read-only): List cheques with optional filters and pagination.
- **List Contacts** (read-only): List contacts.
- **List Letters** (read-only): List letters.
- **List Postcards** (read-only): Retrieve a list of postcards with optional filtering and pagination.
- **List Templates** (read-only): List templates.
- **List Webhooks** (read-only): Retrieve a list of configured webhooks with optional filtering and pagination.
- **Delete Bank Account**: Delete a bank account by its id.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete a contact by its id.
- **Delete Template**: Delete a template by its id.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a webhook subscription.
- **List Self-Mailers** (read-only): List self-mailers.
